translations.web: Behold, I am against the prophets,” says Yahweh, “who use their tongues, and say, ‘He says.’
translations.bsb: “Yes,” declares the LORD, “I am against the prophets who wag their own tongues and proclaim, ‘The LORD declares it.’”
translations.kjv: Behold, I am against the prophets, saith the LORD, that use their tongues, and say, He saith.
translations.asv: Behold, I am against the prophets, saith Jehovah, that use their tongues, and say, He saith.
